newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacDun buys US business for A$115 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacDun buys US business for A$115 mln.

text.p: Australian industrial group Pacific Dunlop Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to purchase a U.S. safety glove business for A$115 million.

PacDun said Golden Needles Knitting Inc (GNK), based in North Carolina, was the world's leading producer of knitted safety gloves for industrial and commercial markets with annual sales of A$120 million.

PacDun managing director Rod Chadwick said the acquisition would give Ansell a 40 percent share of the U.S. high-specification, cut-resistant glove market, and a strong position in the developing European market.
"GNK represents a major growth opportunity for Ansell over the next five years," Chadwick said in a statement.
Chadwick said the acquisition was the latest move by PacDun to make its Ansell division a global leader in barrier protective products for the world's industrial, consumer and healthcare markets.
Ansell had worldwide sales of A$825 million last year.
GNK operates four production facilities in Wilkesboro, North Carolina. Its gloves are used in meat processing plants, metal handling and similar applications.
